value.action: When an information-providing role makes a credible accusation and you have successfully saved them, publicly frame their survival as a puzzle for the village to solve. Guide the discussion by asking questions like 'Why is the investigator still alive?' or 'This claim feels more credible because the evils clearly failed to kill them.' This validates their claim without revealing your role or making you their sole defender, helping the village reach the correct conclusion organically.
